title: Free LLM API Github — What Actually Works in 2026
meta_description: What does Free LLM API Github cost in 2026 (spoiler: nothing), and how do you set it up properly? Covers free tiers, open-source alternatives and honest…
intro: Here's the premise: free llm api github should cost nothing to get started. Between open-source projects, free API tiers and self-hostable tools, it can. Below is the working setup we actually use, plus the gotchas we hit.

We'll walk through Gemini API Free Tier, Groq Free Tier, Hugging Face Inference, and Openrouter Free Models — and finish with the questions people actually ask, so you can check before you buy anything. You shouldn't have to buy anything.

sections.heading: Gemini API Free Tier
paragraphs: First, the thing that actually matters: Google's Gemini API has a free tier with per-minute and per-day model quotas — no credit card required.

Which, in day-to-day terms, means: You sign in with a Google account, create a key in AI Studio, and call the models over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The free tier's rate limits are more than enough for a blog that writes a few posts a day, and the paid tier is only for when you outgrow the quotas.
For a personal project or side business, this covers you without breaking a sweat.
bullets: Create a Google AI Studio API key
Point any OpenAI-compatible client at the Gemini OpenAI endpoint
Set LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_API_KEY and LLM_MODEL and this engine writes with it

sections.heading: Groq Free Tier
paragraphs: First, the thing that actually matters: Groq offers a free tier for open-weight LLMs with some of the fastest inference speeds anywhere.

In other words: Llama-family models run on dedicated hardware that makes response times almost embarrassing, and the free tier has enough tokens for a daily content job. It plugs into this engine through the same OpenAI-compatible interface as every other provider.
Keep it this simple and you'll be ahead of most tutorials out there.

sections.heading: Hugging Face Inference
paragraphs: The short version: Hugging Face hosts thousands of open models and offers free inference access for personal projects.

The upshot: It is the natural home for open-weight models: you find the model card, read the license, and call it through the Inference Providers API. Free allowances vary by model and provider, but the catalog is the largest in the open ecosystem.
Write down what you change and why — your future self will thank you.

sections.heading: Openrouter Free Models
paragraphs: Skip the fluff and start here: OpenRouter aggregates dozens of model providers behind one API, and a set of models carry a ':free' suffix with no credit card required.

The upshot: One key, one endpoint, many backends — you can switch models in a config line and keep the same code. The free models rotate, but the pattern is stable: check the model list, pick the ones marked free, done.
For a personal project or side business, this covers you without breaking a sweat.
